privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.lead: What we store, why, and who can see it.

sections.p: When you create an account we keep your name, email, phone (optional), username and avatar. When you plan a trip we keep its title, dates, cities, day-by-day schedule, expenses, tasks and the photos you upload.

Your IBAN is saved on your profile and copied into your membership record of each trip you join. Only members of that trip can see it, solely so they can transfer settlements to you. It is never shown outside your trips or used for anything else.
The app runs on Google's Firebase platform: Authentication, the Firestore database and Hosting. Data travels encrypted over HTTPS and is stored in Google data centres under their security terms.

Trip data (schedule, expenses, photos) is visible to that trip's members only. Your profile is private, except your name and username, which let friends find you. We do not sell your data or share it with advertisers.
Places, photos and maps come from Google Maps; flight data from AeroDataBox. These services receive your search queries only, never your personal data.
The trip report and PDF are generated on your device; whatever you share from them is your decision and responsibility.

You can delete your account and data at any time from the Account page. If you are the sole owner of an active trip with members, transfer ownership first. Data is permanently deleted after a short retention period.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.lead: By using BoardingPass you agree to these short terms.

sections.p: BoardingPass is a tool for organising group trips: schedule, expenses, tasks and memories. It is provided as is, and we keep improving it.
Use the app for lawful purposes only. Do not upload content that harms others or violates their rights, and do not try to access trips you are not a member of.
The app does not sell tickets, book hotels or move money. Any booking you make on external sites is governed by those sites' terms, and we accept no liability for it.
Expense calculations are an aid; transfers between members happen outside the app and remain the members' own responsibility. Check the IBAN before transferring.
The suggested share to support the app is entirely voluntary and on your honour; it creates no obligation.
Partner offers shown in Explore come from independent parties; we do not guarantee their content or prices.
We may update these terms from time to time; the last-updated date appears at the top of this page.

help.title: Help Center
help.lead: Quick answers to the most common questions.

sections.h: How do I create a trip?
sections.p: On the home page tap "Start a new trip", enter the title, type, dates and first destination. After creating it you add cities, stays and transport inside the trip.
From the Members tab inside the trip: invite by name, phone or username, or share the invite link. Invitees need to sign in to accept.

A fixed kitty is an amount collected up front from every member equally, and expenses are deducted from it. An open kitty has no upfront amount: whoever pays picks who is with them and the amount is split among them. Personal expenses stay out of the group maths and are visible to you only.

"My summary" shows who pays whom, to the halala. "Direct" makes everyone pay the people who actually paid for them; "Minimal" reduces the number of transfers. The totals at the top always equal the transfers below.

sections.h: Why am I asked for an IBAN?
sections.p: So trip members can transfer what they owe you. It is saved once on the Account page, shown only to members of your trips, and the app recognises your bank from the number.

sections.h: How do I export the report or PDF?
sections.p: From the Memories tab: "View report" opens the full trip dashboard, and "Download PDF" builds a phone-sized file with the schedule, expenses and high-quality photos, with a preview before saving or sharing.
Check your connection and refresh the page. If it persists, email us at the address below with a short description.
